1일 1회1회 1개씹어 섭취

비오틴 표시량(500μg/4g)의 80~180%

Made by (주)한풍네이처팜 · Once a day · 1 tablet

One daily serving (once a day, 1 tablet) provides 5000μg of labelled Biotin (per 550mg of product). Its officially recognised functions are listed below.

Why this product

  • 5000μg of Biotin per serving (1 tablet)
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)한풍네이처팜

Biotin nutritional functions (officially recognised)

  • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Biotin labelled (5000μg / 550mg), 80~180%

Coliform Negative

Storage 고온다습(30℃ 이상, 상대습도 75% 이상) · 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who take Biotin daily
